needs_human.note: Time spent paused counts toward the candidates stage's embedding budget (F2). The spec says the stage waits while paused, and also gives a 600 s budget, but does not say whether the pause counts against that budget.; When a CLIP regenerate is recorded during a running fetch, its CLIP task can run while the flag is still true. The storyboard leg then finds the gate holding and skips the storyboard, and the flag is reset only when the fetch ends. The requeued fetch rebuilds from the video, but the 'storyboard leg writes the storyboard as before' step of I7 does not happen in that ordering.

The spec does not say whether paused time counts toward the candidates stage's embedding budget (EMBED_BUDGET_SECONDS). The code counts it (F2).; The spec does not say what priority the text rebuild of a read-but-unindexed YouTube .loft gets when prioritize queues a fetch instead (F3).
